text_block_list.text:
Night. On my way home after finishing 
work, I ran into Sakura Chiyono O peering 
into something.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um... I heard a familiar voice coming from 
the kitchen...
BAKUSHIIN!!!!
(KABOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh?! Hahaha! It appears my secret special 
training has been discovered!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
*cough* *cough*... Th-This pitch-black 
mound... are these burned sweets, desu 
ka...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I thought to make homemade treats for my 
little sister. So I've been Bakushin-ing 
with full spirit!

The other day, Sakura Bakushin O said she 
figured out what her sister needed and 
insisted on making 'preparations' alone, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Could the thing her sister needed be...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! In that moment, I remembered. The day 
I tried to make sweets, imitating my 
sister—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just like today, it was a charred, 
complete disaster! While I was left 
totally devastated, she said this to 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
'You really are clumsy, Big Sis. But... 
that's why I think it's great. It's just 
so you, and I love that!'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That is all that matters! Whether 
it's sweets or running, doing it 'your 
way' is what counts!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
She doesn't have to Bakushin like me. 
Running in her own unique way... that is 
the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to convey that to her! With my 
sweets—the very ones she said she loved 
because they were 'just like me'...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
By pouring all my heart and soul into them 
with everything I have!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just as you believed in her, Trainer-san. 
...Fufu, shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A present...? Woah! These are 
homemade treats from Big Sis, aren't 
they?!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*munch*... *giggle*, ahaha! So bitter! 
It's my favorite flavor—Big Sis's taste!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Little Sister—it is just like those 
treats. There are sweets that only I can 
make, and sweets that only you can make. 
That is how it should be...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You... should just run your own race! 
There is no need to be chained to 
Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll do my best! I'm gonna Bakushin 
just like you, Big Sis!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...! *gasp*! I gotta Bakushin... 
Bakushin even harder!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There are treats that only you can make. 
And the exact same goes for running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin is my way of running. I know that 
you must have—

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Just like these sweets... I must have a 
running style of my own...?

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
I see... I am me. Not Big Sis... and not 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who wants to take 1st 
place...!

Eventually, the day of the 'Chibi Horse 
Girl Footrace Tournament' arrived once 
more. The result of the race was—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
We did it! We did it! She took 2nd place! 
Incredible! She got 2nd place...!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Big sissss! I did itttt!

A battered, hardly well-made treat. Yet, 
it deepened the bond between the clumsy 
sisters.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Woaaaah! She placed 6th! She did her best! 
That girl gave it her absolute all!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Big sissss! I... I, you know... I gave it 
my all in my own way!

A battered, hardly well-made treat. Step 
by step, the two clumsy sisters continued 
moving forward.
